spans.s: पर्शुः [parśuḥ], 1 An axe, a hatchet; cf. परशु.
Ved. A curved knife. -f. The supporting or sidewall of a well.
Comp. पाणिः an epithet of Gaṇeśa.
पर्ष [parṣa], a. Voilent, rough (as wind); देवे वर्षति यज्ञविप्लव- रुषा वज्राश्मपर्षानिलैः
पर्षः [parṣḥ], Ved. A bundle, sheaf; खले न पर्षान् प्रति हन्मि भूरि
An assembly, a meeting, conclave; परीतो भूतपर्षद्भिः
Particularly, a religious synod or assembly; चत्वारो वेदधर्मज्ञाः पर्षत्
. ˚वलः A member of an assembly; पर्षद्वलान् महाब्रह्मैराट नैकटिकाश्रमान्
पार्शवः [pārśavḥ], A warrior armed with an axe.
The part of the body below the arm-pit, the region of the ribs; वामं पार्श्वं विनिर्भिद्य सुतः सूर्य इव स्थितः
The side, flank (in general) (of animate or inanimate objects), पिठरं क्वथदतिमात्रं निजपार्श्वानेव दहतितराम्
Ved. A curved knife. -र्श्वः An epithet of the twentythird Tīrthaṅkar of the Jainas.
A fraudulent expedient, a dishonourable means.

The extremity of the fore-axle of a wheel. (पार्श्वम् is used adverbially in the sense of 'near to', 'by the side of', 'towards'; केनाप्युत्क्षिपतेव पश्य भुवनं मत्पार्श्वमानीयते Ś.7.8; so पार्श्वात् 'from the side of, away, from'; पार्श्वे 'near', 'at hand', 'at the side'; नमे दूरे किंचित् क्षणमपि न पार्श्वे रथजवात् Ś.1.9;
.)-Comp. -अनुचरः an attendant, a servant; विसृष्टपार्श्वानु- चरस्य तस्य
. -अपवृत्त a. bent on one side (one of the defects of diamonds); Kau.

. -अस्थिःn. a rib. -आयात a. one who has come very near.-आर्तिः f. pain in the side, pleurisy. -आसन्न a. sitting or standing by the side. -उदरप्रियः a crab. -उपपीडम्ind. (to laugh) so as to hold one's sides. -ग, -गम, -चर, -स्थित a. being close to, standing by the side of.-गः an attendant, a servant; व्यादिदेश गणशो$थ पार्श्वगान् कार्मुकाभिहरणाय मैथिलः
being at the side, being near or close to, attending upon.
sheltered. -चरः a servant, an attendant; विपिने पार्श्वचरैर- लक्ष्यमाणः
;14.29. -दः an attendant, a servant.-देशः the side (of the human body), the ribs. -नाथः the Jaina pontiff. the 23 rd Tīrthaṅkara (Mar. पारस- नाथ).
परिवर्तनम् turning round from one side to the other in a bed.

N. of a festival on the twelfth day of the first half of Bhādrapada (when Viṣṇu is supposed to turn upon the other side in his sleep).-भागः the side or flank. -मण्डलिन् m. N. of a particular posture in dancing. -मानी the longer side of an oblong. -वक्त्रः an epithet of Mahādeva. -वर्तिन् a.
being by the side, attending, waiting upon.
an attendant; भूयः स भूतेश्वरपार्श्ववर्ती किंचिद् विहस्यार्थपतिं बभाषे
a companion, associate; अमुना ननु पार्श्ववर्तिना
शूलः, लम् a shooting pain in the side.
pleurisy. -सूत्रकः a kind of ornament. -स्थ a. being at the side, near, close, proximate; सुरपतिमपि श्वा पार्श्वस्थं विलोक्य न शङ्कते Bh.
an assistant of a stagemanager; cf. पारिपार्श्वक.
पार्श्वकः [pārśvakḥ], (-की f.) A swindler, pilferer, thief.
Near, at hand, by the side, close to; पार्श्वतः प्रस्थितं तमनवस्थितं प्रियाः
; प्रायेण भूमिपतयः प्रमदा लताश्च यत् पार्श्वतो भवति तत् परिवेष्टयन्ति
(= पश्चात् q. v.); पार्श्वतः करणं प्राज्ञः
पार्श्वतीय [pārśvatīya], a. Being on or situated at the side.
पार्श्विकः [pārśvikḥ], a. (-की f.) [पार्श्वे भवः ठक्] Belonging to the side.
One who seeks money by fraudulent means, a thief.
One who earns money through the instrumentality of one's own kinsmen after knowing their needs by means of staying by the side (पार्श्व) of the king; Dānasāgara, Bibliotheca Indica 274,
पार्षत [pārṣata], a. (-ती f.) Belonging to the spotted antelope;
. -तः A patronymic of king Drupada, and of his son Dhṛiṣṭadyumna;
पार्षती [pārṣatī], 1 An epithet of Draupadī; सूतस्येति वचः श्रुत्वा पार्षती दुःखिता$वदत्
A train, retinue (of a god); शर्वस्य सह पार्षदैः
One present at an assembly, a spectator, an assessor.
A text-book received by any particular grammatical school.
पार्षद्यः [pārṣadyḥ], A member of an assembly, an assessor; सभ्याः सदस्याः पार्षद्याः सभास्ताराः सभासदः Abh.
The back or rear in general; शुद्धपार्ष्णिरयान्वितः
The extremity of the fore-axle of a four-horse chariot. -Comp. -ग्रहः a follower. -ग्रहणम् attacking or threatening an enemy in the rear.
ग्राहः an enemy in the rear; ˚चिन्ता N. of a chapter in Kau. A. (7.13). बलिनो$फजलस्यैते पार्ष्णिग्राहाः प्रमाथिनः Śiva
a general commanding the rear of an army.
an ally who supports a prince;
; पार्ष्णिग्राहं च संप्रेक्ष्य तथाक्रन्दं च मण्डले
.-त्रम् a rear-guard, a body of forces in the rear, reserve.-वाहः an outside horse. -विग्रहः an attack by an enmy in the rear; मा विधान्मुधा कृतानुतापस्त्वयि पार्ष्णिविग्रहम्
. -सारथिः a charioteer who drives one of the outside horses.
